data.one_liner: Type-safe Dart API for accessing Windows gamepads via Win32
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-level, type-safe interface to query and control up to four XInput gamepads on Windows. It wraps native Win32 calls, exposing state, vibration, and battery information.
use_when: You need to read gamepad input in a Flutter or Dart app on Windows
You want vibration or battery info without dealing with raw FFI
You prefer a clean, object-oriented API over low-level Win32 calls
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform gamepad library
You require advanced game engine features beyond input polling
strengths: Supports up to four controllers with clean state objects
Includes vibration and battery info out of the box
